0022600112.text: The Lakers, 1-0 and 2nd in the Pacific, visit the 0-1 Utah Jazz, who sit 12th in the West, in the Lakers' third game of the season. Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), and Jake LaRavia (ankle sprain), while Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise). The Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 131-107 home win on April 12, 2026, and the teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series.
